request.style: English, classic soul, warm male lead vocal with female backing singers, Rhodes piano, horn section, bass, tight drums, hopeful groove, 92 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In a little town called Nazareth upon the Sabbath day
He stood up in the synagogue the way he did each week
They handed him the scroll of the prophet Isaiah
He found the place where it was written and he began to speak

[Chorus]
The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me
Because the LORD has anointed me
To bring good news to the poor
He has sent me to bind up the brokenhearted

[Verse]
To proclaim liberty to the captives
And release to those who are bound
To comfort all who mourn
To proclaim the year of the LORD's favor

[Chorus]
The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me
Because the LORD has anointed me
To bring good news to the poor
He has sent me to bind up the brokenhearted

[Bridge]
A crown instead of ashes
The oil of gladness instead of mourning
A garment of praise instead of a faint spirit
Today this Scripture has been fulfilled in your hearing

[Outro]
Good news to the poor
Good news to the poor
